title: Exploring Perspectives on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Creativity of Knowledge Work: Beyond Mechanised Plagiarism and Stochastic Parrots
reasoning: This is a position paper that explores conceptual and theoretical frameworks for creativity, authorship, and plagiarism. While it discusses religious and spiritual metaphors for creativity (Section 2.5) and the ethical/legal frameworks of intellectual property (Section 4), it does not empirically study, evaluate, or benchmark LLMs on religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
